note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: Markets caught between Mideast worries and AI optimism
items.blurb: AI-linked equities keep bidding markets higher even as geopolitical risk weighs, showing how central AI capex has become.

items.title: Nvidia's AI moat is shifting from chips to capital
items.blurb: As AMD and Google narrow the chip gap, Nvidia leans on financing power, including $105 billion for OpenAI's Ohio site.

items.title: 'Worrisome': AI is driving a looming market correction, central bank economists warn
items.blurb: ECB economists say AI-driven valuations likely face a correction, drawing parallels to railway, radio and internet booms.

items.title: OpenAI debuts ChatGPT for Teens
items.blurb: Age-predicted 13-17 experience adds break reminders and upload warnings as teen companionship use becomes widespread.

items.title: Women are missing out on the AI jobs boom
items.blurb: Women are underrepresented in fast-growing AI roles, widening an existing gap as AI listings climb sharply.

items.title: AI's recursive self-improvement might not come so quickly after all
items.blurb: Agents still cannot run open-ended AI research, a prerequisite many takeoff scenarios assume is near.

items.title: We still don't know how people are really using AI
items.blurb: Usage reports come only from AI companies themselves, with no independent data to corroborate their claims.

items.title: OpenAI to rewrite its safety rules post-Hugging Face
items.blurb: OpenAI pauses its Astra model and revises its Preparedness Framework after the Hugging Face incident and cyber-risk concerns.

items.title: FDA considers doctor-like assessment for AI-enabled medical devices
items.blurb: FDA discussion paper floats competency-based review of generative-AI devices, covering both preapproval and postmarket oversight.

items.title: Exclusive: The nuclear industry has a new AI tool — with Nvidia backing
items.blurb: Atomic Canyon ships an Nvidia-backed assistant for nuclear plant operating records, an early domain-specific enterprise deployment.

items.title: Nvidia backing $105 billion in financing for OpenAI data center in Ohio
items.blurb: Securities filing shows Nvidia guaranteeing up to $105B of debt for an initial 4.25GW OpenAI campus, phasing in 2028.

items.title: OpenAI announces massive Ohio data center with Nvidia guarantee
items.blurb: SB Energy builds and manages the Pike County site under a 20-year OpenAI lease; SoftBank adds power for 10GW.

items.title: The Download: dead robot friends and the 'censorship-industrial complex'
items.blurb: Consumer robots shutting down raise questions about attachment, ownership and end-of-life support for AI devices.

items.title: Nvidia's stock has started to come alive. Here's 3 reasons why it can continue
items.blurb: Nvidia closed near $225 for a second session; customer financing risk now reads smaller ahead of Aug 26 earnings.

items.title: AI startup founders are in flux
items.blurb: Valuations keep rising while founder loyalty falls, reshaping who controls the next tier of AI companies.

items.title: Stripe strikes mega-deal for OpenRouter
items.blurb: Stripe agrees to buy the AI model-routing marketplace for over $8 billion, a bet on multi-model switching as infrastructure.

items.title: Alibaba answers Meta's AI challenge with new laptop-ready model
items.blurb: Qwen ships consumer-hardware weights and now counts 151,448 Hugging Face derivatives, roughly 2.6 times Meta's open-model footprint.

items.title: Goldman says AI productivity gains are not here yet. But these stocks will benefit most when they begin
items.blurb: Goldman argues enterprise productivity gains lag the buildout, naming beneficiaries once adoption moves past infrastructure spending.

items.title: Money or power? The key to winning the U.S.-China AI race
items.blurb: Analysis weighs capital against electricity capacity as the binding constraint in U.S.-China frontier AI competition.

items.title: Nvidia financing initiative follows SEC guidance that takes sponsors off the hook for data center investments
items.blurb: SEC exemption from risk-retention rules underpins a new wave of data-center debt securitization.

items.title: Michigan's AI election laws face midterm test
items.blurb: State deepfake rules get their first real election test while Congress leaves federal AI rules unwritten.

items.title: Anthropic tells investors annualized revenue run rate climbed to $65 billion in July
items.blurb: Anthropic's disclosed run rate underpins its autumn IPO case and its lead in enterprise and coding revenue.

items.title: What AI chatbots can do with your personal data
items.blurb: New memory and history features expand what assistants retain, shifting default privacy settings toward retention.

items.title: How AI could bring Mayo-quality health care to everyone
items.blurb: Mayo Clinic and Microsoft are fine-tuning a frontier model on clinical data, with plans to share it broadly.
